text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Maya is citing musical differences!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Oho, now that's a classic line. 
A clash of creative visions. Ah, youth at 
its finest."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Pout~~! Take me seriously~~! 
Maya is having a genuine crisis here!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Pearl-san and the others might be mature! 
They're pretty and smell really nice! 
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, you haven't said a single word 
about quitting. 
You might complain, but deep down you've 
already made up your mind, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Maya knows that too."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Hey, girls!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
According to yesterday's spinach 
divination, what we must do is 'observe 
and learn'! 
Thus, humble Fukukitaru suggested coming 
to observe a live music venue!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at the stage! Look at the live 
performance! 
While we're cleaning up, we shall observe 
meticulously!

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
Next, could you help clear out those 
wooden crates over there? 
It's such a huge help having Umamusume 
lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Even so, a real band is truly incredible, 
isn't it?! 
Both the music and the sight of them 
performing just draw you right in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look at that drum setup! 
—He hit the cymbal with an uppercut! An 
uppercut!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The guitar isn't losing out either! 
Tilting her whole face upwards—! 
Tooth picking!! It's the legendary 
HA-BI-KI!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I were to express this passion... 
Mmm-mm, let's fight!!

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text: Hey, cut it out!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that cheering is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... that's right, bands are supposed 
to be cool like that! 
Is Maya... really going to be okay with 
these two...?!)

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me! You're the cleaners, right? 
There are empty plastic bottles scattered 
over there~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, yes! Right away~! 
.........*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mayano!!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
......... 
...You two, you're gonna get scolded again 
if you keep goofing off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*grin!!*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
............*pfft*. 
Jeez, that's not fair~! You're making me 
laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (...I know. Even Maya "knows".)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(What these two are thinking. 
Why they're always doing weird things.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(This is just who they are. It's their 
way. 
...It's what they do whenever they want to 
cheer someone up.)

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good work today! You really 
saved my bacon~... So, tell you what, 
wanna practice a song? You guys are in a 
band too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Is that really okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyohoho~~! What great fortune, good luck 
has arrived, maximum great blessing! 
Let's turn the stage lights on bright, 
too! Flashy and dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sounds goo~d... Owner, would it be 
alright? 
May we paint this entire stage in our own 
colors?

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead~. I'll even turn on the 
lights, so show me what you've got. 
Today was your band study day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(The stage...! The real stage, where the 
protagonist 
in the movies was shining so bright! I-If 
so—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaa~~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Just like those people bathing in the 
cheers earlier, 
just like a cool band in the movies! 
...Maya can also—!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—! Th-Then let's get ready! 
Pearl-san! Fukukitaru-san—!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: L-Let's get pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I knew this was gonna happen!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah... I get what they're trying to 
do, buuut...! 
It's not like they're bad people, but 
still~...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez, what am I supposed to doooo~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (Wait, Brian-san? Why is she here—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bwa... bwabwa... bwaa... ng...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're soooo teeeeerrrible!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Ah?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah.
